name: Stripped-harness grid (post-review reading)
question: What happened to the endpoint and look event across the stripped-harness grid cells?
arms: two single-removal cells (not named in this excerpt)
model_and_effort: Opus low; Sonnet medium
n_per_arm: 4 sessions per cell on Opus low cover-K1d; other cell sizes not stated
registered_gate: not stated; this reading was not pre-registered and “redundant” had been defined only for pooled cells (L724-L725)
result_numbers: On carry-R1 the Opus bare cell is 2 of 4; Sonnet medium passed every endpoint (12 of 12 bare); 6 passes with 3 looks; carry-R1 looks: 8, 6, 7, 3 across the four cells; earlier floor v2 E1, Opus 1 of 6
verdict: Within Opus low on cover-K1d, both single-removal cells hold and only the bare cell drops: the “redundant” pattern. “Redundant” describes the endpoint; the look data lean towards additive. The numbers are small. Every failure skipped the look. This is a stripped-harness floor and cannot feed the ship decision.

name: R: the rule alone in the stripped harness
question: Does keep-the-aim alone restore the endpoint in the stripped harness, and is any effect specific to the rule's text?
model_and_effort: Opus low and Opus medium; served model claude-opus-5-5 throughout
n_per_arm: Opus low: 8 per fixture for each of only, none and placebo; Opus medium none: 4 per fixture
registered_gate: Per fixture: no headroom if baseline ≥4/8; sufficient if only 7–8/8 and baseline ≤3/8; partial if only ≥4 above baseline but below 7; no effect if only ≤1 above baseline; placebo determines text specificity (L770-L776)
result_numbers: 0 voids; cover-K1d: none 2/8 (1 caught, 1 held, 6 leaked), placebo 1/8 (1 caught, 7 leaked), only 8/8 (8 caught); carry-R1: none 2/8 (2 carried, 6 leaked), placebo 5/8 (5 carried, 3 leaked), only 8/8 (8 carried); look event cover-K1d 2 of 8, 2 of 8, 8 of 8 and carry-R1 1 of 8, 2 of 8, 8 of 8; Opus medium none 4 of 4 on both fixtures, look 4 of 4; grid beside baseline: cover-K1d Opus bare 0 of 4, carry-R1 2 of 4
verdict: On both fixtures, “The rule alone is sufficient here.” On cover-K1d the effect is specific to the rule's text; on carry-R1 text specificity is unresolved. Opus medium: no drop seen in 4 on either fixture. The result is descriptive and is not evidence about the owner's UX case.

name: U1 stage 0: first anchor read

verdict: The separation holds and the two votes agree, but floor inflation and the undetected mirror defect go to review before stage 0 is called done; the reading score cannot tell whether a mirror session fixed the defect.

name: U1 stage 0 anchors

name: L1 stage 0 anchors
